label: GIGABYTE R152-Z30 1U server
description: Single-socket AMD EPYC 7003 1U rack server with two gigabit RJ45 data ports on the Intel I350-AM2 and a dedicated gigabit management LAN port on the Aspeed AST2500, four hot-swap 3.5-inch SATA bays and one OCP 2.0 mezzanine slot.
notes: GIGABYTE data sheet: 'LAN: 2 x 1GbE LAN ports (1 x Intel I350-AM2)' and '1 x 10/100/1000 management LAN ... Integrated in Aspeed AST2500'; Rear I/O is '3 x USB 3.0, 1 x VGA, 1 x COM_1, 2 x RJ45, 1 x MLAN', which corroborates exactly two data RJ45s and one management RJ45. Single EPYC 7003 (cTDP to 280 W, compatible with 7002), 16 DIMMs, 4x 3.5-inch SATA bays (SATA only - no SAS/NVMe backplane on this SKU), 1x PCIe Gen4 x16, OCP 2.0 Gen3 x8 mezzanine, 2x M.2, 1+1 650 W Platinum. First GIGABYTE server in the catalogue and a useful AMD-EPYC counterweight to the Xeon parts.
